blocks.head: alt UserX is not near a device and the device exists
alt UserX is near the device
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device and ImmediateRelayUser is near the device
alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device, CachingRelayUser is near the device, and CachingRelayUser has no cached command
alt CachingRelayUser is near the device and has cached command L
alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by share and UserY
alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by revoke and UserY

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < Cloud | ('cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ..) , ...) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , ....) > $ UserX 'shareAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY) 
= < Cloud | ('cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , ..) , ..) , ...) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , ....) > $ Cloud 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'share' ; UserY) .

eq < Cloud | ('cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , ..) , ...) , ....) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , .....) > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY) 
= < Cloud | ('cloudKey' : 'secret' , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ....) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , .....) > $ Cloud 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY) .

eq < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , ..) > < Device | (...) > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L) 
= < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , ..) > < Device | (...) > $ RelayUser 'proxy' Device | (L) .

eq < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ..) > $ Cloud 'deliverCommand' CachingRelayUser | (Device ; Command) 
= < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : Command , ..) > .

eq < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : L , ..) > < Device | (...) > $ CachingRelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L) 
= < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ..) > < Device | (...) > $ CachingRelayUser 'proxy' Device | (L) .

eq < Device | ('trusted' : Users , ..) > $ RelayUser 'proxy' Device | (encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'share' ; UserY) 
= < Device | ('trusted' : (Users , UserY) , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('trusted' : (Users , UserY) , ..) > $ RelayUser 'proxy' Device | (encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY) 
= < Device | ('trusted' : Users , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < Device | (...) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, Device) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < Device | (...) > .

event_rules.rule:

event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > < cloudB | (Device : ('trusted' : Trusted , ....) , .....) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, cloudB, Device, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > < cloudB | (Device : ('trusted' : Trusted , ....) , .....) > .
